# authwise_application_secrets (Data Source)

An application's secret (its OAuth `client_secret`), for authenticating it to the token endpoint. kit creates it and returns it once, so the secret is kept in state: treat the state as sensitive.

Formerly `authwise_client_secret` (kit#968): a `moved` block from `authwise_client_secret` carries the state across, `secret` included. This data source lists every one under a parent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `application_id` (String) Parent identifier `application_id`; overrides the provider default.
- `issuer_id` (String) Parent identifier `issuer_id`; overrides the provider default.
- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default.

### Read-Only

- `application_secrets` (Attributes List) Every application_secret under the parent, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--application_secrets))

<a id="nestedatt--application_secrets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `application_secrets`

Read-Only:

- `application_secret_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `expires_at` (String)
- `hash_enabled` (Boolean)
- `name` (String) Full resource name.
